reviews.comment: Take the class, he wants you to be successful. He intentionally pushes you out of your comfort zone to help you grow as a founder. His primary goal is to see his students start their own companies, and he provides incredible support to make that happen. The class is challenging but well worth it.

A very great teacher and can tell that he cares about his students. Grades are very strict, though, but he pushes you to be the best you can be. Probably won't get an A in this class, but B's are very, very possible.

Professor D is a great instructor who truly cares about his students and enjoys giving back. His entrepreneurship class is engaging, and you learn a lot from the way he teaches. He does grade the case assignments a bit tough, but the class itself is manageable and very enjoyable. Great professor, I can say a lot of good things about him.

Prob one of my favorite profs so far, he's really understanding and gives life lessons along with his content; he's also the CEO of a $100mil+ company so it was really cool listening to his personal experiences. The course itself is a blowoff if u have common sense & do the assignments but it's worth showing up to listen to him talk about his story

If you want to learn about what business really is and how to run one, this is your guy! He may be new to teaching, but he is not new to the world of business. He is accessible outside of class and appreciates active participation. Study tip: during class take very vague notes (headers) and then follow-up with textbook material on your own time. :)

He's awesome! He's new to teaching, but he has so much experience running a business that he makes the class interesting. He shares great stories of his experience in the industry. His class is lecture heavy with readings and group projects. He doesn't share his slides so showing up to class is important. If you take notes and read, you'll be fine.
